meta.title: Rows that carry an existing id are updated in place, only the omitted ones are deleted
gaps: No setup recipe creates a fresh draft BOQ project with three line items.
The available tokens provide only one lineItemUuid, so the request cannot identify existing L1, L2, and L3 or verify their individual ids, quantities, serial numbers, and in_active status.
No operation or library case expresses the required PATCH line-item update semantics.
